description: Keyword search over 787daily's Puerto Rico news archive by title/summary and optional section (Act 60 stories count as business). Accents are optional: 'mayaguez' finds Mayagüez. Returns news only (no guide listings), newest first, each with a link to 787daily's summary page, which credits and links the outlet's original report. For semantic/vector search, use search_news.

query.description: Keyword search over title + summary; omit for the newest stories

name: keyword_search_news
